note: Abstention benchmark. `expect: []` marks a task no tool of the standard profile fits: the right outcome is that the gate enables nothing. `tuning` tasks were used to choose the routing rule (first as a dev/held-out pair, then together, because the first rule overfit its dev half). `final` tasks were written afterwards and scored once: they are the number to quote. Negatives include deliberate traps that share a word with the catalog (schedule, cancel, plan, report, list, search, memory). Positives are phrased like a person, not copied from descriptions. Run with `npm run abstain`.
